packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 is the native rewrite and has no compiler API: typescript-eslint throws on it (peer typescript <6.1.0; tracked in typescript-eslint#10940), as do Next's type check and Serwist. Stay on 6.x until typescript-eslint supports 7.

Vercel builds only on Node.js 24.x and 22.x: with engines.node at 26.x the deploy fails ('invalid or discontinued Node.js Version'). Keep Node (engines, and CI's setup-node, which Renovate tracks as actions/node-versions) and its types on 24 until Vercel offers 26 in Project Settings.
